name: Laposta Webform
description: Integrate Drupal Webform with Laposta mailing lists.
project_description:
This module provides seamless integration between Webform and Laposta , a leading email marketing service based in the Netherlands. Laposta Webform allows you to add Laposta subscription functionality to any webform, giving you full control over form design while automatically syncing subscribers to your Laposta lists. The killer feature: let visitors choose which list(s) to subscribe to using dynamic list selection elements.

 Features 
 
 Simple API integration with Laposta 
 Webform handler for any webform 
 Subscribe to fixed or dynamic Laposta lists 
 Multiple list selection support (dropdown or checkboxes) 
 List filtering: restrict which lists visitors can see and subscribe to 
 Custom webform elements: Laposta list select and Laposta list checkboxes 
 Supports all Laposta field types (text, numeric, date, single select, multiple select) 
 Smart field mapping with auto-mapping by field name 
 Required field validation before subscription 
 Opt-in field support for GDPR compliance 
 Configuration through Drupal's admin interface
